speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malignant Ovarian Carcinoma with Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion. The presence of a large ovarian mass, rapid abdominal girth increase, right-sided pleural effusion, and shortness of breath in a 40-year-old woman is clinically diagnostic of advanced ovarian cancer with peritoneal carcinomatosis causing transudative fluid accumulation, rather than benign conditions like pyelonephritis.
